blocks.text: Integrated Cybersecurity, Compliance, Privacy and Managed Services

1. Understand
Clarify the business context, requirement and scope
2. Assess
Evaluate current controls, evidence and vulnerabilities
3. Prioritize
Separate immediate risks from longer-term improvements and agree on a practical action plan
4. Implement
Develop or improve controls, documentation and processes
5. Validate
Review implementation, verify evidence, retest where applicable and confirm outstanding actions
6. Sustain
Establish ownership, monitoring and reporting
